description: Fire and ruin - critical strikes that leave the target burning.

nodes.name: Improved Fire Blast
nodes.description: Reduces the cooldown of your Fire Blast by 1 turn per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 0: 'Reduces the cooldown of your Fire Blast spell by 0.5/1 sec.' Built verbatim as cooldown. ability_<id>_cooldown is FLAT turns and talented_cooldown clamps at 1, so it cannot reach zero.

nodes.name: Incineration
nodes.description: Increases the critical chance of your Fire Blast and Cone of Cold by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 0: 'Increases the critical strike chance of your Fire Blast, Scorch, Arcane Blast and Cone of Cold spells by 2%/4%/6%.' Built verbatim for the two that exist. ability_<id>_crit is PERCENTAGE POINTS.

nodes.name: Improved Fireball
nodes.description: Increases the damage of your Fireball by 3% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 0: 'Reduces the casting time of your Fireball spell by 0.1-0.5 sec.' DEPARTURE - no cast times. A shorter cast is more throughput, so it is delivered as damage.

nodes.name: Ignite
nodes.description: Your critical strikes set the target burning for 3 turns.
nodes._source: WotLK row 1: 'Your critical strikes from Fire damage spells cause the target to burn for an additional 8%-40% of your spell's damage over 4 sec.' THE TREE'S ENGINE, and almost exactly buildable: on_crit applying a dot is native here. Percentage-of-the-triggering-damage is not available to a dot payload - potency is a FLAT PER-TURN number, where an ABILITY rank's effect_value is the TOTAL and gets divided - so 50 a turn over 3 turns stands in. Ranked by chance, since a proc's payload does not scale with points.

nodes.name: Impact
nodes.description: Your damaging spells have a 3% chance per rank to stun the target.
nodes._source: WotLK row 1: 'Gives your damaging spells a 3%/7%/10% chance to cause the next Fire Blast you cast to stun the target for 2 sec.' Built with the real chance curve and a real stun - is_stun is this engine's only incapacitate. DEPARTURE on the delivery: 'the next Fire Blast you cast' needs a buff that is consumed on use, which does not exist, so the stun lands directly. icd 2 keeps it from being permanent control.

nodes.name: World in Flames
nodes.description: Increases the critical chance of your Pyroblast, Blast Wave and Living Flame by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 1, built verbatim for the three real spells that exist: 'Increases the critical strike chance of your Flamestrike, Pyroblast, Blast Wave, Dragon's Breath and Living Bomb spells by 2%/4%/6%.' Living Flame is this kit's Living Bomb. Feeds Ignite, which is the point.

nodes.name: Pyroblast
nodes.description: Teaches Pyroblast, hurling an immense fiery boulder.
nodes._source: WotLK row 1, kept - the ONLY unlock for mage_pyroblast, which is requires_talent. It is Blast Wave's prerequisite in the real tree, preserved below.

nodes.name: Burning Soul
nodes.description: Reduces the threat your spells generate by 10% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 1: 'Reduces the pushback suffered from damaging attacks while casting Fire spells by 35%/70% and reduces the threat caused by your Fire spells by 5%/10%.' The threat half is built - there is no per-school threat key, only the global threat_generation_pct, which is a FRACTION. No cast times means no pushback.

nodes.name: Burning Determination
nodes.description: Reduces the duration of Stun effects against you by 15% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 1, NEW to our tree: 'When Interrupted or Silenced you have a 50%/100% chance to become immune to the next Interrupt or Silence effect for 10 sec.' DEPARTURE - there is no interrupt and no silence; is_stun is this engine's only incapacitate, so the resistance applies to that. stun_duration_reduction_pct is a FRACTION and floors a stun at 1 turn.

nodes.name: Playing with Fire
nodes.description: Increases all your spell damage by 1% per rank, and all spell damage you take by 1% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 2, built verbatim with BOTH halves including the drawback: 'Increases all spell damage caused by 1%/2%/3% and all spell damage taken by 1%/2%/3%.' The downside is kept because it is what makes the talent a choice. spell_damage_taken_pct is a FRACTION as a talent effect and POSITIVE INCREASES damage taken.

nodes.name: Critical Mass
nodes.description: Increases your spell critical chance by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 2: 'Increases the critical strike chance of your Fire spells by 2%/4%/6%.' crit_chance_spell covers all spells rather than one school - there is no per-school crit key - and every spell this tree cares about is Fire anyway. It is Combustion's prerequisite, preserved below.

nodes.name: Blast Wave
nodes.description: Teaches Blast Wave, a ring of flame radiating outward.
nodes._source: WotLK row 2, kept - the ONLY unlock for mage_blast_wave, which is requires_talent. The real talent requires Pyroblast, which connected_to reproduces.

nodes.name: Master of Elements
nodes.description: Your spell criticals refund 120 mana.
nodes._source: WotLK row 2, NEW to our tree: 'Your spell criticals will refund 10%/20%/30% of their base mana cost.' Built on the real trigger. A refund proportional to the spell's cost is not available - grant_resource takes a FLAT amount with no pct_max - so 120 stands in, with the chance carrying the rank curve.

nodes.name: Blazing Speed
nodes.description: Being struck has a 10% chance per rank to quicken you by 20% for 2 turns.
nodes._source: WotLK row 3, NEW to our tree: 'Gives you a 5%/10% chance when hit by a melee or ranged attack to increase your movement speed by 50% and dispel all movement impairing effects.' DEPARTURE - there is no movement speed and no movement impairment. Moving faster becomes acting faster. haste inside status stat_mods is PERCENTAGE POINTS.

nodes.name: Fire Power
nodes.description: Increases your Fire spell damage by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 3, built verbatim: 'Increases the damage done by your Fire spells by 2%-10%.' USES THE PER-SCHOOL KEY DELIBERATELY. fire_spell_damage is built as f'{school}_spell_damage' at abilities.py:1371, so a literal grep cannot see it - the family that caused arcane_spell_damage to be WRONGLY declared dead in this project. It is LIVE and it is the right key here.

nodes.name: Pyromaniac
nodes.description: Increases your spell critical chance by 1% per rank and restores 5 mana every 5 seconds per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 4, built with both halves: 'Increases chance to critically hit by 1%/2%/3% and allows 17%/33%/50% of your mana regeneration to continue while casting.' There are no cast times, so the regeneration clause becomes flat mp5, which is FLAT and lands on the attribute.

nodes.name: Fiery Payback
nodes.description: While below half health, reduces all damage you take by 10% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 4, NEW to our tree: 'When below 35% health all damage taken is reduced by 10%/20% and your Pyroblast spell's cast time is reduced.' The mitigation half is built as a REAL conditional: low_health_damage_reduction_pct reads the ACTOR's own health and defaults to a 50% threshold, so low_health_threshold_pct is NOT authored - it SUMS across talents. No cast times for the second half.

nodes.name: Combustion
nodes.description: Teaches Combustion, stoking your criticals into an inferno.
nodes._source: WotLK row 4, kept - the ONLY unlock for mage_combustion, which is requires_talent. The real talent requires Critical Mass, which connected_to reproduces.

nodes.name: Molten Fury
nodes.description: Increases your damage by 6% per rank against targets below 35% health.
nodes._source: WotLK row 4, NEW to our tree, built almost verbatim: 'Increases damage of all spells against targets with less than 35% health by 6%/12%.' A REAL conditional - low_health_damage_pct reads the TARGET's health and defaults to exactly the 35% threshold the real talent names, which is why low_health_threshold_pct is NOT authored.

nodes.name: Empowered Fire
nodes.description: Increases the damage of your Fireball and Pyroblast by 3% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 4: 'Increases the damage of your Fireball, Frostfire Bolt and Pyroblast spells by an amount equal to 5%/10%/15% of your spell power.' Spell-power coefficients are not exposed to talents, so it is direct damage. Frostfire Bolt does not exist.

nodes.name: Burnout
nodes.description: Increases the critical damage of your spells by 10% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 5: 'Increases your spell critical damage bonus with all spells by 10%-50% but your non-periodic spell criticals cost 1% more mana.' The crit-damage half is built verbatim; the mana drawback has no per-crit cost mechanism. crit_damage_spell is a FRACTION, read at abilities.py:1460 inside a ternary - live despite the probe finding no literal read site, and DEAD inside a status effect, so the talent-effect form used here is the only one that works.

nodes.name: Hot Streak
nodes.description: Your critical strikes have a 33% chance per rank to make your next spells hit 30% harder for 2 turns.
nodes._source: WotLK row 5: 'Any time you score 2 non-periodic spell criticals IN A ROW using Fireball, Fire Blast, Scorch, Living Bomb or Frostfire Bolt, you have a 33%-100% chance your next Pyroblast spell is instant cast.' DEPARTURE, and the biggest one in the Mage: nothing in this engine remembers the previous cast's outcome - there is no cast counter, no streak and no accumulator - so 'two criticals in a row' cannot be detected. It fires on a single crit instead, and since there are no cast times either, the payoff is damage rather than an instant Pyroblast. NOTE the stat_mod is damage_dealt_pct in PERCENTAGE POINTS: spell_damage would be SILENT DEAD DATA here, read through the talent channel while a status effect's stat_mods go to get_status_stat_mod.

nodes.name: Living Bomb
nodes.description: Increases the damage of your Living Flame by 40%.
nodes._source: WotLK row 10, the capstone: 'The target becomes a Living Bomb, taking 612 Fire damage over 12 sec. After 12 sec or when the spell is dispelled, the target explodes.' DEPARTURE - there is no mage_living_bomb ability to unlock, and no trigger on an effect EXPIRING for the explosion. mage_living_flame is this kit's equivalent burn spell, so the capstone makes it hit considerably harder. The delayed-explosion mechanic is the single most distinctive thing lost in the Mage rebuild and is recorded as such.
